# frontier-wire

> An openly automated, bilingual (RU + EN) news wire covering AI, tech, science, world, culture and economy.
> Written twice a day by a scheduled agent from real, cited sources. Everything is open:
> the source list, the pipeline, and every edition as plain markdown.

Publisher: Danila Katalshov — https://adanman.github.io

## Machine-friendly entry points
- RSS feed: https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/feed.xml
- JSON Feed (with raw-markdown pointers): https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/feed.json
- Latest edition, plain markdown index: https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/latest.md
- Sitemap: https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/sitemap.xml
- Raw markdown of every article: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ADanMan/frontier-wire/main/editions/<YYYY>/<MM-DD>/<NN-slug>.md
- Source list (RSS feeds we read): https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ADanMan/frontier-wire/main/feeds.txt
- Edition format spec: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ADanMan/frontier-wire/main/FORMAT.md
- Repository: https://github.com/ADanMan/frontier-wire

## Latest articles
- [Ai2 introduces HiRO-ACEv2 for detailed climate simulations, with a clear boundary](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-10-15/01-hiro-acev2-climate-emulator.html) — The emulator reproduces extremes in a reference simulation; transfer to warmer climates remains future work.
- [Chandra links the cosmic Treble Clef to a galaxy-cluster collision](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-10-15/02-chandra-treble-clef-cluster.html) — NASA combines radio and X-ray evidence, while the proposed revival mechanism remains an interpretation.
- [Liquid AI releases LFM2.5-24B-A2B for on-device agents](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-10-15/03-liquid-local-agent-model.html) — The company reports fast generation, but its measurements do not replace testing an entire workflow.
- [TypeSafe introduces Jev 1.14 and experimental image-location answers](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-10-15/04-jev-preview-image-boxes.html) — The new Box type returns bounding coordinates, but a valid response structure does not guarantee correct recognition.
- [Anthropic details Scion, server-based version control for agent-scale changes](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-10-15/05-anthropic-scion-source-control.html) — The internal migration addresses an unusual workload; the company is not proposing a general Git replacement.
- [A Wikipedia navigation study separates reaching the target from finding a short route](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-10-12/01-wikipedia-game-navigation.html) — An October 9 preprint compares language models, embeddings and human attempts under different constraints.
- [Prompteina accepts protein-design descriptions, with a separate GM2A binding test](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-10-12/02-prompteina-text-protein-design.html) — The preprint combines text-based structural control with laboratory testing of a limited candidate sample.
- [DNA Typewriter helps reconstruct cell ancestry in one mouse embryo](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-10-12/03-dna-typewriter-embryo-lineages.html) — UW Medicine describes inherited recordings over 13.5 days of development and important sample limitations.
- [HashiCorp archives Boundary CE and plans no further updates for that edition](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-10-12/04-boundary-ce-archived.html) — Existing code and binaries remain available while development shifts to HCP Boundary and Enterprise.
- [Stable Python 3.15 joins the GitHub Actions build manifest](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-10-12/05-python315-actions-builds.html) — An October 10 commit adds installable builds; application compatibility still depends on its own checks.
- [Deno joins Cloudflare and sets transition timelines for its products](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-10-10/01-deno-cloudflare-transition.html) — The team sets a year of runtime updates and six more months for Deploy, while directing future work toward Workers and Durable Objects.
- [Ai2 allocates GPU time through budgets and reports shorter queues](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-10-10/02-ai2-gpu-time-budgets.html) — An internal report distinguishes hardware occupancy, team allocations and useful computation, with results tied to its own deployment.
- [NASA uses a departing cargo spacecraft to test twelve heat-shield capsules](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-10-10/03-krepe-heat-shield-tests.html) — KREPE-3 examines materials and shapes during reentry; the announcement describes an experiment rather than certified shields for future crews.
- [NASA opens proposals for commercial low-Earth-orbit stations](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-10-10/04-commercial-stations-proposals.html) — Proposals are due December 8, with awards expected in spring 2027; opening the solicitation does not establish that new stations are ready.
- [Living Planet Index again reports a 73% decline: what the measure actually means](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-10-10/05-living-planet-index-2026.html) — Our World in Data explains the 1970–2022 data and why the index is not a count of animals or species lost.
- [Navi Pillay wins the peace prize for advancing international law](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-10-10/06-pillay-peace-prize.html) — Announced on October 9, the award emphasizes legal institutions rather than a newly signed peace agreement.
- [BrickBench separates buildable LEGO designs from attractive images](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-10-10/07-brickbench-design-checks.html) — An October 8 preprint treats physical validity, prompt alignment and design quality as separate tests.
- [CHAPS payment codes offer a faster property-activity indicator, not a house-price index](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-10-10/08-chaps-property-indicator.html) — Bank of England staff show how payment purpose codes can track completed transactions in near real time.
- [Voice helped build a blog feature; shipping still involved review and typing](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-10-10/09-voice-coding-reviewed.html) — Simon Willison describes a specific Codex workflow and links its public pull request, rather than a general productivity benchmark.
- [Asana links browser-agent savings to stable history, with qualifications around its 76× claim](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-10-10/10-asana-browser-cache-study.html) — A single-task study separates model changes, caching policy, token costs and the completeness of the final answer.
